Applies the four outlier detection methods to every simulated dataset in `rawdata_simulations.parquet`:
robust z-scoring, RewML Box-Cox/Yeo-Johnson, SHASH-z and SHASH-i.

Outputs, read by `1.2_Simulation_Analysis.Rmd`:

- `simulation_results_metadata.parquet`: one row per observation, with the flags from each method
- `simulation_diagnostics.parquet`: one row per fit, with convergence, degeneracy and parameter estimates

The provided output files are the ones used in the paper. Rerunning this file overwrites them.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(arrow)
library(cellWise)
library(rrobot)

data_dir <- "data"
```

## Settings

The paper uses all 1,000 simulations, all distributions, contamination levels and iForest thresholds.
For a smaller run, shorten any of the first four settings.
Fits are saved in batches of `batch_size` simulations, and finished batches are skipped on rerun, so clear `batch_dir` after changing the settings.

```{r}
n_sims        <- 1000
distributions <- c("df_normal", "df_T", "df_laplace", "df_gamma", "df_chisq", "df_weibull")
percentages   <- c("1%", "5%", "10%", "20%", "30%")
thr_iso_grid  <- c(0.5, 0.55, 0.6)   # iForest+ score thresholds (the paper uses 0.6)

thr1_grid  <- c(2.4, 2.58, 2.8, 3)   # SHASH refit thresholds (the paper uses 3)
thr0_fixed <- 2.58
thr_fixed  <- 3

# degenerate fit: more than 1% of points beyond |z| = 20 (rrobot defaults)
degen_max_abs_z <- 20
degen_min_frac  <- 0.01

batch_size <- 50
batch_dir  <- file.path(data_dir, "batches")
```

## Data

```{r}
df_results <- read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, "rawdata_simulations.parquet")) %>%
  mutate(percentage = factor(percentage, levels = c("1%", "5%", "10%", "20%", "30%"))) %>%
  filter(simulation   <= n_sims,
         distribution %in% distributions,
         percentage   %in% percentages,
         threshold    %in% thr_iso_grid)

cat("rows:", nrow(df_results), "\n")
```

## Helpers

```{r}
tail_type <- function(dist_name) {
  if (dist_name %in% c("df_T", "df_laplace", "df_normal")) "both" else "upper"
}

thr1_label <- function(t) gsub("\\.", "_", as.character(t))

flag_by_tail <- function(z, thr, tail) {
  if (tail == "upper")      z > thr
  else if (tail == "lower") z < -thr
  else                      abs(z) > thr
}

# Warnings from one fit are joined as "a | b | c"; most specific label first
classify_warning <- function(msg) {
  if (is.na(msg)) return("none")
  if (grepl("gamlssML estimation failed", msg, fixed = TRUE)) return("fit_failed")
  if (grepl("singular convergence", msg, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("optim_singular")
  if (grepl("convergence problem|iteration limit|function evaluation limit",
            msg, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("convergence")
  if (grepl("OpenMP|thread", msg, ignore.case = TRUE)) return("openmp_notice")
  "other"
}
```

SHASH fit that records warnings, errors, convergence and degeneracy instead of stopping.
Estimates are on the link scale (log sigma, log tau), as `SHASH_out` returns them.

```{r}
fit_shash <- function(x, tail, thr1, method_init, thr_iso = 0.6) {
  msgs      <- character(0)
  degen_msg <- NA_character_

  result <- withCallingHandlers(
    tryCatch({
      res <- rrobot::SHASH_out(
        x,
        thr0        = thr0_fixed,
        thr1        = thr1,
        thr         = thr_fixed,
        tail        = tail,
        method_init = method_init,
        thr_iso     = thr_iso,
        maxit       = 100,
        max_abs_z   = degen_max_abs_z,
        min_frac    = degen_min_frac
      )
      list(out_idx    = res$out_idx,
           converged  = isTRUE(res$converged),
           last_iter  = res$last_iter,
           degenerate = res$degenerate,
           max_abs_z  = res$max_abs_z,
           n_extreme  = res$n_extreme,
           est        = res$SHASH_coef,
           error      = NA_character_)
    }, error = function(e) {
      list(out_idx = NULL, converged = NA, last_iter = NA_integer_,
           degenerate = NA, max_abs_z = NA_real_, n_extreme = NA_integer_,
           est = NULL, error = e$message)
    }),
    # the degeneracy warning is stored on its own, not with the other warnings
    SHASH_degenerate_fit = function(w) {
      degen_msg <<- conditionMessage(w)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    },
    warning = function(w) {
      msgs[[length(msgs) + 1]] <<- conditionMessage(w)
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  all_msgs <- c(result$error, msgs)
  all_msgs <- all_msgs[!is.na(all_msgs)]
  getp <- function(p) if (is.null(result$est)) NA_real_ else unname(result$est[[p]])

  list(
    out_idx        = result$out_idx,
    converged      = result$converged,
    last_iter      = result$last_iter,
    singular       = any(grepl("singular", all_msgs, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    optim_singular = any(grepl("singular convergence", all_msgs, ignore.case = TRUE)),
    fit_failed     = !is.na(result$error),
    degenerate     = result$degenerate,
    max_abs_z      = result$max_abs_z,
    n_extreme      = result$n_extreme,
    degen_msg      = degen_msg,
    est_mu         = getp("mu"),
    est_sigma      = getp("sigma"),
    est_nu         = getp("nu"),
    est_tau        = getp("tau"),
    warned         = length(all_msgs) > 0,
    error          = if (length(all_msgs) > 0) paste(all_msgs, collapse = " | ") else NA_character_
  )
}
```

## Methods

Runs all methods on one dataset. Returns the per-observation flags; the per-fit diagnostics go to `DIAG_STORE`.

```{r}
run_methods <- function(.x, .y) {
  x        <- unlist(.x$outlier_infused_values)
  org      <- unlist(.x$original_values)
  true_out <- unlist(.x$true_outliers)
  n        <- length(x)

  dist_name <- as.character(.y$distribution)
  thr_iso   <- as.numeric(.y$threshold)
  tail      <- tail_type(dist_name)

  # RewML Box-Cox / Yeo-Johnson
  rryj_msg <- NA_character_
  flagged_rryj <- tryCatch({
    yj <- as.vector(cellWise::transfo(x, type = "bestObj", robust = TRUE, standardize = TRUE)$Y)
    flag_by_tail(yj, 3, tail)
  }, error = function(e) {
    rryj_msg <<- e$message
    rep(NA, n)
  })

  # Robust z-scoring (median and MAD)
  emp_msg <- NA_character_
  flagged_emprule <- tryCatch({
    rrobot:::emprule_rob(x, thr = 3, tail = tail)
  }, error = function(e) {
    emp_msg <<- e$message
    rep(NA, n)
  })

  # SHASH-z and SHASH-i for each thr1
  flag_cols <- list()
  diag_rows <- list()

  for (t1 in thr1_grid) {
    lab <- thr1_label(t1)
    z <- fit_shash(x, tail, t1, method_init = "emprule")
    i <- fit_shash(x, tail, t1, method_init = "isoplus", thr_iso = thr_iso)

    flag_cols[[paste0("flagged_z_thr", lab)]] <-
      if (!is.null(z$out_idx)) seq_len(n) %in% z$out_idx else rep(NA, n)
    flag_cols[[paste0("flagged_i_thr", lab)]] <-
      if (!is.null(i$out_idx)) seq_len(n) %in% i$out_idx else rep(NA, n)

    diag_rows[[length(diag_rows) + 1]] <- tibble(
      method         = c("SHASH-z", "SHASH-i"),
      thr1           = t1,
      singular_error = c(z$singular,       i$singular),
      optim_singular = c(z$optim_singular, i$optim_singular),
      fit_failed     = c(z$fit_failed,     i$fit_failed),
      degenerate     = c(z$degenerate,     i$degenerate),
      max_abs_z      = c(z$max_abs_z,      i$max_abs_z),
      n_extreme      = c(z$n_extreme,      i$n_extreme),
      degen_msg      = c(z$degen_msg,      i$degen_msg),
      est_mu         = c(z$est_mu,         i$est_mu),
      est_sigma      = c(z$est_sigma,      i$est_sigma),
      est_nu         = c(z$est_nu,         i$est_nu),
      est_tau        = c(z$est_tau,        i$est_tau),
      warned         = c(z$warned,         i$warned),
      error_msg      = c(z$error,          i$error),
      iter_converged = c(z$converged,      i$converged),
      last_iter      = c(z$last_iter,      i$last_iter)
    )
  }

  diagnostics <- bind_rows(diag_rows) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(
      method         = c("RewML Box-Cox/YJ", "Robust Z-Scoring"),
      thr1           = NA_real_,
      singular_error = NA,
      warned         = c(!is.na(rryj_msg), !is.na(emp_msg)),
      error_msg      = c(rryj_msg, emp_msg),
      iter_converged = NA,
      last_iter      = NA_integer_
    ))

  key <- paste(.y$simulation, .y$distribution, .y$threshold, .y$percentage, sep = "|")
  DIAG_STORE[[key]] <<- diagnostics %>%
    mutate(simulation   = .y$simulation,
           distribution = .y$distribution,
           threshold    = .y$threshold,
           percentage   = .y$percentage)

  tibble(
    obs_index              = seq_len(n),
    original_values        = org,
    outlier_infused_values = x,
    true_outliers          = true_out,
    flagged_rryj           = flagged_rryj,
    flagged_emprule        = flagged_emprule
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(flag_cols))
}
```

## Run in batches

```{r}
dir.create(batch_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

batches <- seq(1, n_sims, by = batch_size)

for (b in batches) {
  flag_file <- file.path(batch_dir, paste0("flags_", b, ".parquet"))
  diag_file <- file.path(batch_dir, paste0("diag_",  b, ".parquet"))

  if (file.exists(flag_file) && file.exists(diag_file)) {
    cat("Skipping batch", b, "(already done)\n")
    next
  }

  batch_sims <- b:min(b + batch_size - 1, n_sims)
  cat("Running simulations", b, "to", max(batch_sims), "\n")

  DIAG_STORE <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())

  batch_flags <- df_results %>%
    filter(simulation %in% batch_sims) %>%
    group_by(simulation, distribution, threshold, percentage) %>%
    group_modify(run_methods) %>%
    ungroup()

  write_parquet(batch_flags, flag_file)
  write_parquet(bind_rows(as.list(DIAG_STORE)), diag_file)

  rm(batch_flags, DIAG_STORE)
  gc()
}
```

## Combine and save

```{r}
df_flagged <- map_dfr(batches, function(b) {
  read_parquet(file.path(batch_dir, paste0("flags_", b, ".parquet")))
})

df_diag <- map_dfr(batches, function(b) {
  read_parquet(file.path(batch_dir, paste0("diag_", b, ".parquet")))
}) %>%
  mutate(warning_class = sapply(error_msg, classify_warning))

write_parquet(df_flagged, file.path(data_dir, "simulation_results_metadata.parquet"))
write_parquet(df_diag,    file.path(data_dir, "simulation_diagnostics.parquet"))

cat("flag rows:", nrow(df_flagged), " diagnostic rows:", nrow(df_diag), "\n")
```

## Fit summary

```{r}
df_diag %>%
  filter(method %in% c("SHASH-z", "SHASH-i")) %>%
  group_by(distribution, percentage, method, threshold, thr1) %>%
  summarise(
    n_fits         = n(),
    pct_warned     = round(100 * mean(warned, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_degenerate = round(100 * mean(degenerate, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    pct_converged  = round(100 * mean(iter_converged, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    max_last_iter  = max(last_iter, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_degenerate)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```
